Oku Musashi Hanno Tourism Association is hosting morning yoga events at Nora Naguri Central Park. A professional instructor will guide you through gentle stretches in the soft morning light and fresh air. Perfect for beginners and those with tight muscles.

【Event Dates and Times】
• September 6 (Sunday) 7:00–8:00 a.m.
• October 11 (Sunday) 7:00–8:00 a.m.
• November 1 (Sunday) 7:00–8:00 a.m.

【Location】Nora Naguri Central Park (607-1 Shimo-Naguri, Hanno, Saitama)

【Fee】3,000 yen per person (includes breakfast)

【Registration】Advance reservation required. Open to non-facility members as well.
